sources.title: CoCA: Step-Level Reward for Free in RL-Finetuned T2I Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: By introducing step-level reward by contribution-based credit assignment, our method allows T2I diffusion models to generate images that better align with nuanced human intentions, promoting more reliable and controllable human-AI interaction.
